title: Existence of the coefficient restriction tensor comparison
statement: For the data of lem-pbc-coefficient-restriction-tensor-comparison, there exists a normalized natural isomorphism between the tensor model after restriction along the coefficient isomorphism and the restricted tensor model.

proof.text: Apply ringIso_tensor_transport to c on the original small pro-etale site. Its kflat_iff and flat_iff clauses show that termwise restriction preserves flat-term K-flat representatives. Its totalIso and total_naturality clauses supply a natural isomorphism from restriction of signed total tensor to signed total tensor of restrictions. The scalarModules and scalarRestriction abbreviations are definitionally the proEtaleRingModules and pbcRestrict used here.

Resolve every homotopy object by the existing independent-coefficient flat-term K-flat resolution. Transfer the exact tensorRight clause to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply resolvingRepresentativesFullyFaithfulWhiskering to the homotopy quotient and its quasi-isomorphism localization, then transfer through quotientCompQhIso to the complex localization. This gives full faithfulness of precomposition along the product of the representative inclusions followed by Q.

Use tensorComparisonDescent with the exact restriction factorization mapDerivedCategoryFactors, the supplied representative isomorphisms of aX and z, and the preceding signed-total natural isomorphism. The factorization is an isomorphism on every complex, hence on representatives and their tensors. The resulting natural isomorphism has direction aX.tensor followed by derived restriction to the tensor of the two restricted factors; take its inverse to obtain the displayed conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YS, 06YU, 03EK, 07A4 and 04VK. H3 uses the existing ring-isomorphism tensor transport and representative descent theorems; no new unresolved statements or changes to the supplied tensor models.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorComparison_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R)
    (z : ProEtaleTensorModel X
      ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R))
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X S) :
    Nonempty (((pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom).prod (pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom)) ⋙ z.tensor ≅
      aX.tensor ⋙ pbcDerivedRestrict c.hom)
